explication: Netty is an asynchronous, event-driven networking framework for protocol servers and clients. The principal workflow is: an application configures a channel pipeline; transport events enter the pipeline; handlers decode and transform ByteBuf data; application handlers receive results or write responses back through the pipeline. The tree also shows substantial buffer allocation, codec/compression, TLS/ALPN, QUIC, DNS, and SPDY capabilities. Wiring for several unsampled modules is represented only where documented by the README or sampled APIs.
